sourceEvidence.title: Sr. Principal Mechanical Engineer
sourceEvidence.quote:
**Basic Qualifications for the Sr. Principal Mechanical Engineer:**
* Bachelor's degree in a related STEM discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math) with a minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience; OR a master's degree in a STEM discipline with 6 or more years of experience.
* Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings.
* Experience with mechanical assembly processes.
* Experience in technical writing and presentations.
* Ability to obtain a US Government Secret Clearance.
* U.S.
